passages.note: Assembly floor vote page: Ward is in the Ayes list, 58-17-5, so not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: The state shall not deny or interfere with an individual’s reproductive freedom in their most intimate decisions, which includes their fundamental right to choose to have an abortion and their fundamental right to choose or refuse contraceptives.
passages.note: Bill text page prints the operative section but names no voter; same record group as the vote page.

rows.reasoning: Ward voted Aye on SCA 10 (2021-2022), whose operative section says the state "shall not deny or interfere with an individual’s reproductive freedom in their most intimate decisions" — a declared right that names no stage or limit. Silence is not a clause, so it cannot establish "keep abortion legal at every stage of pregnancy, with no time limit"; it shows only the pro-legality side, and it does not separate that rung from "keep abortion legal through the second trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health."
needs_source: Ward's own words or a record of his on a gestational time limit for abortion (e.g. a vote or sponsorship on a bill that sets or removes a viability limit under the Reproductive Privacy Act)
